title: Q-DEQ: Discrete Solving and Quantization for Deep Equilibrium Models in Time Series Forecasting under Edge Deployment Coding Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2609.24042v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Edge deployment motivates forecasting models with compact parameter storage and low-bit representations. Deep equilibrium models (DEQs) obtain implicit depth by repeatedly applying a shared layer, reducing the parameter cost of explicit layer stacking. Their usual Anderson solver, however, searches for update coefficients in the continuous real domain. We propose Q-DEQ, which formulates local updates in DEQ forward solving as discrete optimization problems. Candidate directions are constructed from the current state and iteration history, and a local quadratic residual model is used to evaluate their combinations. Binary encoding of the direction coefficients yields a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem that can be solved by simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM). translated_title: Q-DEQ：面向边缘部署编码约束下时间序列预测的深度均衡模型离散求解与量化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.24042v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：边缘部署促使预测模型需要紧凑的参数存储和低比特表示。深度均衡模型（DEQ）通过重复应用共享层来获得隐式深度，降低了显式层堆叠带来的参数成本。然而，其常用的Anderson求解器是在连续实数域中搜索更新系数。我们提出Q-DEQ，将DEQ前向求解中的局部更新表述为离散优化问题。候选方向由当前状态和迭代历史构建，并使用局部二次残差模型来评估它们的组合。方向系数的二进制编码产生一个二次无约束二进制优化（QUBO）问题，该问题可以通过模拟退火（SA）或相干伊辛机（CIM）求解。在完成不动点求解后，通过重新前向传播对共享层的权重和激活值应用W8A8伪量化。我们评估（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Q-DEQ，将深度均衡模型前向求解中的局部更新重构为可由模拟退火或相干伊辛机求解的QUBO离散优化问题，并结合W8A8量化，在边缘部署约束下实现高效的时间序列预测。
en_tdlr: Q-DEQ reformulates local updates in DEQ forward solving as a QUBO discrete optimization problem solvable by simulated annealing or coherent Ising machines, combined with W8A8 quantization, enabling efficient time series forecasting under edge deployment constraints.
